title: GatewayBench: Unified Capability and Security Evaluation Platform for MCP Gateways
abstract: arXiv:2610.23449v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents have increasingly interacted with external environments by invoking tools, with Model Context Protocol (MCP) emerging as a standard interface for connecting agents to heterogeneous tools and services. As organizations deploy agents at scale, MCP gateways have become a critical middleware layer for aggregating, governing, and shaping the tool surface exposed to agents. Despite the growing importance of MCP gateways in agentic systems, no prior work has systematically studied how gateway design affects agent capability, efficiency, and security. To address this gap, we introduce GatewayBench, the first unified evaluation framework and benchmark for MCP gateways. We characterize gateway architectures into two major paradigms: flattened gateways and hierarchical gateways. translated_title: GatewayBench：面向MCP网关的统一能力与安全评估平台
translated_abstract: AI智能体越来越多地通过调用工具与外部环境进行交互，模型上下文协议已成为连接智能体与异构工具和服务的标准接口。随着各组织大规模部署智能体，MCP网关已成为聚合、治理和塑造暴露给智能体的工具面的关键中间件层。尽管MCP网关在智能体系统中的重要性日益增长，但此前尚无工作系统性地研究网关设计如何影响智能体的能力、效率与安全性。为填补这一空白，我们提出了GatewayBench，这是首个针对MCP网关的统一评估框架与基准测试。我们将网关架构归纳为两大范式：扁平化网关与层级化网关。GatewayBench包含覆盖六个领域的524个任务，以及一个来自251个真实MCP服务器的11,118个真实世界工具的工具池。为模拟大规模部署……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了首个针对MCP网关的统一评估框架与基准GatewayBench，通过覆盖六个领域的524个任务和来自251个真实MCP服务器的11,118个工具，系统评估扁平化与层级化两类网关架构对智能体能力、效率和安全性的影响。
en_tdlr: Introduces GatewayBench, the first unified evaluation framework and benchmark for MCP gateways, which uses 524 tasks across six domains and 11,118 real-world tools from 251 authentic MCP servers to systematically assess how flattened and hierarchical gateway architectures affect agent capability, efficiency, and security.
